snippet.title: Legionbound - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Legionbound is a retro party-based RPG where battles play out in autobattler style, but the choices you make still decide the run. You recruit heroes, stack synergies, unlock skills, and try to keep your legion from falling apart when the waves start piling up.

Play the demo NOW!
Check out Legionbound on Steam!
